text:
maria: Customer reporting intermittent 401s and occasional billing-related failures when hitting /v1/generate. Need a super tiny repro + SDK snippets we can send to them. They can run curl or paste a short script.

dan: Can you grab one or two failing request IDs and the timestamp please? also which SDK (py/js/go) they use.
maria: They use our python SDK v0.9.3 and also tried curl. Provided two request ids: r_01a2b3c4 and r_01d2e3f4 (from their logs). Happen mostly between 2026-03-15T17:22:10Z and 2026-03-15T17:32:05Z.
kevin: Ok. Ask them to run a minimal curl that captures headers + body and include the response headers (we need x-request-id, x-rate-limit, x-account). Example to paste back:

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REPLACE_WITH_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"hello"}' \\
  --max-time 10 \\
  -v 2>&1 | tee curl_output.txt
```

kevin: That `-i` and `-v` will dump response headers and we can match x-request-id to our logs. Ask them to paste the first 200 lines of curl_output.txt and attach it.
maria: I'm going to send them minimal SDK snippets too. Please review before I send.

dan: Quick py snippet (no deps aside from requests) for a small repro:

```python
# python minimal repro (requests)
import requests
url = "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate"
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer REPLACE_WITH_KEY", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
data = {"model": "redwood-alpha-1", "input": "test repro"}
r = requests.post(url, json=data, headers=headers, timeout=10)
print(r.status_code)
print(r.headers.get('x-request-id'))
print(r.text[:1000])
```

olivia: JS/Node minimal (fetch):

```javascript
// node minimal repro (node 18+)
import fetch from 'node-fetch';
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer REPLACE_WITH_KEY', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-alpha-1', input: 'test repro' }),
  timeout: 10000
});
console.log(res.status);
console.log(res.headers.get('x-request-id'));
console.log(await res.text());
```

maria: and a tiny Go snippet if they prefer: 

```go
// go minimal repro
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "net/http"
  "io/ioutil"
)
func main(){
  body := []byte(`{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"test repro"}`)
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST","https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(body))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization","Bearer REPLACE_WITH_KEY")
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type","application/json")
  client := &http.Client{}
  resp, err := client.Do(req)
  if err!=nil { fmt.Println("err",err); return }
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  b, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  fmt.Println(resp.StatusCode)
  fmt.Println(resp.Header.Get("x-request-id"))
  fmt.Println(string(b)[:1000])
}
```

kevin: Also ask them to capture SDK debug logs. For python SDK: set env `REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug` and run the same snippet, then share the portion around the failing request id. For node: `DEBUG=redwood:* node app.js`. 

olivia: For our debug bundle, ask them to run:

```bash
mkdir debug-bundle && cp curl_output.txt debug-bundle/ && tar czf debug-bundle.tgz debug-bundle && # scrub tokens before upload
# instruct them to replace actual keys before sending: sed -i 's/Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._-]\+/Bearer <REDACTED>/g' debug-bundle/curl_output.txt
```

maria: Also request the billing metadata they see: customer_account_id, plan, and any invoice id shown in portal. That helps correlate billing failures.

dan: If they can reproduce a single failing request, include the raw headers we should match: `x-request-id`, `x-account-id`, `x-plan-id`, `date`, and any `x-rr-cache` if present.

support-bot: Please remember to never paste full API keys in public channels. Use <REDACTED> in any attachments.

maria: Great. I'll send this as a micro repro playbook and ask them to run the curl and one of the tiny SDK snippets, attach curl_output.txt, the debug logs (log lines around x-request-id), and the scrubbed bundle. Will follow up with the request ids once they reply. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
